messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin

Yes, it runs Harlo OS, which has three power modes, so you can turn it down from the full ~500 W. At full power that's about $36 a month at 10¢/kWh. Only the full-power figure is published. What do you pay for power?
can i lower the watts each seperatly on the to lets say only using 250watts instead of 500
Handed to the team · H15 per-side power control and lower-mode wattages aren't in the product facts;

I've confirmed only the H15's full-power figure, about 500 W. I don't have tested numbers for its lower modes, and I can't confirm you can turn the Bitcoin and Dogecoin sides down separately. I'd rather not guess, so I've passed your 250 W question to our hardware person. The team picks it up Monday at 10am ET and the answer comes by email. What email should it go to?

If staying under 250 W is what matters most, the Harlo B30 already has tested numbers for that. Its ECO mode runs 18 TH/s at 230 W, which is about $17 a month if your power costs 10¢ per kWh.
